method.base_pose: upright trunk at fixed reference height .55369 m; all joints use active k1_walk task default_joint_pos
method.projection: Orthographic along trunk +x; y-z convex native-geom silhouettes; trunk-relative coordinates
method.mesh_projection: 2-D convex hull of compiled mesh vertices, matching convex collision silhouette; no visual-only geometry included
method.scope: trunk and both arms only; projected solid geometry is not ball-inflated, contact area, interception probability, or dynamic safety

self_collision.distance_cross_check: Separate compiled diagnostic copy disables nativeccd only for libccd distance queries; official source and primary model unchanged, no dynamics steps. Backend disagreement means signed distance cannot be treated as certified clearance.
self_collision.note: Filtered pairs are not monitored by default self collision; zero detected contacts is not proof against visual-shell overlap or unsampled path collision.

static_reach_bound.method: Triangle inequality: norm(shoulder anchor) + sum descendant body offset lengths + native shape circumradius + 1 micrometre numerical slack; independent of root orientation and arm joint angles
static_reach_bound.scope: Conditional static exclusion only when instantaneous trunk origin z stays below threshold. No statement about base rise, jumping, ball-flight height changes, contact timing, or dynamic safety.

gaps.decision: native first; no collision geometry added; shoulder-root contact remains unverified

sequence: 0.30 rad candidates after H0 decision and controlled trial checks
recommendation.approval_status: H0 informs already-authorized controlled H1 trials; static report alone is not execution or dynamic safety evidence
required_next_evidence: controller joint ownership and transition protocol settled by H0 decision
